photo.title: Photo access is needed
photo.body: To choose an album and build a slideshow, the app needs access to your device's photos. Photos aren't copied into the app — they stay on your device.

audio.title: Music access is needed
audio.body: To choose a device music file for background music, access permission is needed. Music files aren't copied into the app — they stay on your device.

blocked.title: Photo access is turned off
blocked.body: Allow photo access in Settings to choose an album.

partial.title: Full album access is needed
partial.body: Only some photos are currently selected. To show albums by folder, switch to "Allow all photos" in Settings.

audio_blocked.title: Music access is turned off
audio_blocked.body: Allow music file access in Settings to choose background music from your device.
